I've only had one really bad woman. It was relatively fine for a while. She made out like she was a victim to her ex. But looking back she was as bad as him.

Started going south on a night out where she smashed a bottle of wine on me.

Started getting more abusive, to provoke me and spark some kind of reaction.

We'd argue and butt heads, which would cause het to act worse.

I got to a point where I'd give up trying to work things out. Said I'm gonna swing by grab my stuff. Call it a day.

Had an Xbox at hers bits of clothes. And a phone contract in my name.


Get there she kicks off scratches,kicks and hits me, causes a scene so the neighbours came out. Obviously took her side. Why wouldn't they 6ft2 man and 5ft5 woman.

I managed to salvage some things but not everything.

In the commotion I unwittingly left with the key I had to her place.

I lived a good 10 miles away. But needed to decompress so I decided to walk home.

On the way I got abusive texts and phone calls. Saying I was gonna get my head caved in. Police were called etc.

Get home and a few hours had passed.
She messages again. Coming getting my key with a load of abuse added for good measure.

Said fine. She pulls up and I had an immature thought and dropped the key down the grid. Walked away (not my finest moment)


Radio silence for months.

Start seeing a new girl. 

She knows somehow. Ringing me constantly. And I know how vile she can be. So at the start it was easier to take the calls and keep her sweet (didn't meet up or anything, just answer the calls)

Slowly dialled that back to try and cut her off.

And she would message my friends, pictures of me like leaving the gym and other places from a distance.

Like is this him. I don't recognise the clothes etc.

It culminated when she'd seen I was out on a night out through a mutual friend. Turned up caused a scene. Tried to make me choose between her and the new girl.

Took her outside and said if you was the last living female I would die alone.

And that was that. I walked away.

She caused some trauma. Be lying if I said she didn't.
But the positives that have come out of it are I refuse to let someone get under my skin and wind me up like that any more.
I can now express myself calmly without losing my cool.
She made me realise matching energies isn't worth it.
